title: Management of Proximal Humerus Fractures in Adults: a Clinical Trial
official: Management of Proximal Humerus Fractures in Elderlies: a Clinical Trial
summary: Prospective patient registry examining the outcome of three different treatment methods for proximal humerus fractures in elderlies: conservative treatment, open and minimal invasive surgical treatment.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. adults who sustained a Proximal Humerus Fracture within the last week
2. type of Proximal Humerus Fracture AO 11-(A2, A3), 11- (B1, B2, B3)
3. BMI lower than 40 Kg/m2

Exclusion Criteria:

1. stress fractures
2. revision setting
3. open fractures
4. fractures associated with a neurologic lesion; previous fractures or bony procedure at the homolateral side
5. patients unable to understand the procedure or instructions for rehabilitation
6. terminal patients
7. patients presenting multiple injuries
